post.description: Public C-end 瑞诺瓦 AI diagnosis completion. The server owns the public tenant/dealer/store scope; this operation does not accept caller-provided tenant scope and remains lifecycle_handoff_only.

get.description: Public C-end 瑞诺瓦 AI diagnosis report readback for customer share pages. The server owns public tenant scope and requires a shareToken query parameter; it remains lifecycle_handoff_only.
Read-only lifecycle handoff package for the external IoT/customer-care platform. This endpoint never accepts or emits realtime control commands.
